question: What do iPhone XR reviewers say about battery life?
answer:
One reviewer was pleased that the phone arrived with battery life at 100%. [b0c1f95adb9c_0]
Another reviewer said the battery life was low but still above 85%, which they found acceptable. [6f1fc1c01893_0]
A reviewer complained that their phone's battery capacity was lower than their old XR that had been in heavy daily use for four years. [2fd1446e5543_0]
One reviewer called it the worst battery life and said their phone came with 82% battery health. [f70a819224c0_0]
A reviewer reported battery life and overheating problems about four weeks after purchase. [0e8733716715_0]
Other reviewers described the battery as a turn-off at 75%, as needing charging more often than it should, and as running down very fast at 86% health. [c783005fbabc_0] [147314ca0eb4_0] [bc349adb9dc2_0]

chunks.text: 100% Battery Life!!!. I wanted to do this review to help others who may be considering. I don’t usually do reviews but I received a phone that looks to be brand new! My battery life was at 100%! I was so shocked when I seen this because I was expecting atleast a phone with a 90 or lower percent. I almost didn’t buy because I always read one star reviews just to see if everyone has the same complaint but I’m so glad I looked past those and just bought it.
Review. The phone works very well, no scratches or faults. The only thing I’d say bad about it was the battery life was low but it was still above 85% so that was okay
